public_rationale: The statement gives no testable meaning of close. Even reading super-smart as broadly superhuman leaves unanswered whether Marcus meant months, years, capability distance or unresolved scientific problems. Choosing a deadline and benchmark would create a new claim. Later progress therefore cannot fairly produce a supported or contradicted verdict.
limitations: This is not a finding that superintelligence was near or far in 2023.
An absence of recognized superintelligence by the evaluation date would not establish this undefined claim.
